Specification: This module builds and writes out a TLA+ trace module from a TLC counterexample. It computes the set of state variable names appearing in the counterexample, constructs textual conjuncts for initial and next-state relations, and assembles a generated module containing Trace, _init, _next, _terminating, and _spec. The spec is focused on trace serialization and reporting rather than verifying an algorithm directly; it also includes a guard that suppresses output when there is no counterexample state or when console output is disabled in the CounterExample record.
IfThenElse: IF CounterExample.state = {} \/ ("console" \in DOMAIN CounterExample /\ CounterExample["console"] = FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE

/\\ i = TLCGet("level")
/\\ j = i + 1
